I am an old woman farming my small rice plot here in the North West. Rice needs water and good soil, so I will use some NPK and urea if I can get it from the agro-dealer, but only what I can afford — fertilizer prices are high. I will use the seed I saved from last season because improved seed costs too much and I do not always trust what they sell. My grown children and I will do most of the work by hand, but for transplanting and harvest I will need to hire a few hands from the village.
